support_provenance.title: The ESW of Wikidata: Exploratory search workflows on Knowledge Graphs
support_provenance.abstract: This work presents the Exploratory Search Workflows collection, focusing on real-world exploration sessions of Wikidata, and introduces a resource for analyzing real user sessions and understanding query evolution and complexity. The collection includes 234 real exploratory workflows and serves as the first query benchmark for KG management systems for exploratory search.

support_provenance.title: GraphRAG for engineering diagrams: ChatP&ID enables LLM interaction with P&IDs
support_provenance.abstract: This work introduces ChatP&ID, a framework enabling natural-language interaction with smart P&IDs through Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG). ChatP&ID transforms DEXPI-encoded P&IDs into structured knowledge graphs, enabling reliable querying by large language model (LLM) agents and improving response accuracy by 18% over raw image inputs.
